description: Synthetic daily aggregates only. Personal comparison is descriptive; HRV SDNN is not a stress/readiness score or Apple Recovery HRV.

rules.baseline: median of same-source prior complete days within caller calendar cutoff
rules.delta: current minus median in original unit
rules.conflicts: reject entire affected metric; never combine source/day aggregates
rules.notPersistence: Fixtures are synthetic; production health samples are not persisted by this core
